method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, parish, mission, and monastery sources were checked. The authorized private Swiss directory and search results were used for discovery and current practical details, but not as the sole proof of a body's canonical parent. Overlapping jurisdictions were preserved neutrally.

spine_row_proposals.name: Eparchy of Western Europe
spine_row_proposals.reason: The Georgian Patriarchate's current Holy Synod member record names the Eparchy of Western Europe and explicitly includes Switzerland in its territory. The official eparchy page supplies the current eparchy name and public presence. This parent is required to preserve the official immediate hierarchy of the Bern and Zurich Saint Nino parishes.

candidates.name: Arabic-Speaking Resurrection Orthodox Parish in Bellevue
candidates.reason: The current authorized Swiss directory identifies the parish, its Bellevue worship site, and its Antiochian metropolitan. No current official patriarchal, diocesan, or parish source establishing the body was located, so the directory page is retained for verification rather than used alone for publication.

candidates.name: Lausanne Francophone Orthodox Group
candidates.reason: The authorized Swiss directory gives a current worship location, but the Ecumenical Patriarchate's official Metropolis of Switzerland list does not name the group as a parish, mission, chapel, or separate worship site. Saint Gerasimos Parish is published; this group waits for official confirmation of its current status.

candidates.name: Romanian-Language Orthodox Community in Zurich
candidates.reason: The authorized Swiss directory lists the community under the Ecumenical Patriarchate, but it does not appear in the current official Metropolis of Switzerland parish list. The official Magenwil Romanian-speaking parish and Romanian Patriarchate parish in Zurich are separately published and are not treated as substitutes.

candidates.name: All Saints of Helvetia Orthodox Community in Biel
candidates.status: hold for current official diocesan confirmation and worship location
candidates.reason: The current authorized Swiss directory identifies the Korsun community but reports that it is seeking a new worship location. It is absent from the current official Korsun worship-place pages located during this audit. It remains a candidate until the diocese or community publishes its present status.

candidates.name: Joy and Consolation Icon of the Mother of God Ukrainian Orthodox Parish in Laufen
candidates.status: hold for current official UOC confirmation
candidates.reason: The authorized Swiss directory lists the Laufen parish, but it was not found in the official UOC Switzerland reports or the current official Swiss UOC parish pages. It is not merged into the Bern parish without evidence.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Orthodox Missionary Centre in Neuchatel
candidates.reason: An official 2023 UOC report names a missionary centre in Neuchatel. The current Swiss UOC parish page now names Bern, Biel, Thun, Fribourg, and Zurich, but not Neuchatel. The historical report is preserved without presenting the centre as current.

historical_or_superseded.name: Earlier Zurich Resurrection Church address
historical_or_superseded.reason: The older official Korsun page records Narzissenstrasse 10. The parish remains current and is published, but its own current site should be checked before any future address revision.

historical_or_superseded.name: Neuchatel Ukrainian Orthodox missionary centre
historical_or_superseded.status: officially reported in 2023 but absent from the current parish location list
historical_or_superseded.reason: Retained as a candidate rather than published as a current body.
